title: Inversion: advanced · 倒装句（进阶）
pattern: Negative adverbial + auxiliary + subject + verb  ·  Had + subject + V3  ·  Should + subject + base verb
summary: 句首放否定词或条件时，助动词要提到主语前面：Never have I seen it.
explanation: 英语的正常语序是“主语 + 助动词 + 动词”。但当否定副词（never、rarely、seldom、hardly、no sooner 等）放在句首时，句子要**倒装**：助动词或 be 动词移到主语前面。这种结构强调语气，多见于正式书面语和演讲：**Never have I** seen such a beautiful sunset.

常见的倒装结构有：**Not only ... but also**（Not only **did she** pass the exam, but she also won a scholarship.）；**Hardly ... when**（Hardly **had he** arrived when it started to rain.）；**No sooner ... than**（No sooner **had we sat down** than the phone rang.）；**Not until / Only after / Only then**（Not until midnight **did she** return.）。注意：如果 never 不在句首，就不需要倒装：I have **never** seen it.

**条件句省略 if 时的倒装**：把 had、should、were 提到主语前面，就可以不用 if：Had I known（= If I had known）；Should you need help（= If you should need help）；Were he to apologise（= If he were to apologise）。这种写法比 if 句更正式。中文里没有对应结构，理解时要先把它还原成 if 句。
**So / Such ... that** 也能倒装：So quickly **did the news spread** that the whole street knew by noon.（句首是 so + 副词，后面倒装。）否定的“也不”结构 neither / nor 同样倒装：I don't like it, and neither **do you**.
**不要滥用倒装**。中文习惯把“从不”“很少”放在动词前，英语在普通陈述句中不需要倒装，只有否定词位于句首，或句子以 so、such、only 开头时才倒装。倒装句中的助动词要和主语、时态一致，动词保持原形或 V3。
mistakes: ✗ Never I have seen such a view. → ✓ Never have I seen such a view. 否定词在句首时，助动词要放到主语前面。
✗ Rarely we go to the cinema. → ✓ Rarely do we go to the cinema. 句子没有助动词时，要先加 do / does / did 再倒装。
✗ Hardly I had arrived when it started raining. → ✓ Hardly had I arrived when it started raining. hardly 要倒装，并且与 when 搭配；no sooner 才与 than 搭配。

examples.text: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
examples.translation: 我从未见过如此美丽的日落。
examples.note: Never 位于句首，助动词 have 提到主语前面。

examples.text: Rarely do the trains run late on this line.
examples.translation: 这条线的火车很少晚点。

examples.text: Not only did she pass the exam, but she also won a scholarship.
examples.translation: 她不仅通过了考试，还拿到了奖学金。

examples.text: Had I known about the strike, I would have taken the earlier train.
examples.translation: 要是我早知道有罢工，就会坐早一班的火车了。
examples.note: Had I known 相当于 If I had known。

examples.text: Should you need any further information, please contact our office.
examples.translation: 如果您需要更多信息，请联系我们的办公室。
examples.note: Should you need 相当于 If you need，语气更正式。

examples.text: No sooner had we sat down than the phone rang.
examples.translation: 我们刚坐下，电话就响了。

examples.text: So rapidly did the fire spread that the whole street was evacuated.
examples.translation: 火势蔓延得如此之快，整条街都被疏散了。

exercises.translation: 我从没听过这么荒唐的话。
options: Never I
Never have I
I have never
Never I have
exercises.explanation: 否定副词 never 位于句首时要倒装，应为 Never have I heard ...。

exercises.sentence: Had I ___ about the delay, I would have left earlier.
exercises.translation: 要是我早知道会延误，我就会早点出发了。
options: know
knew
knowing
known
exercises.explanation: Had I known 相当于 If I had known，倒装条件句中要用过去分词 known。

exercises.sentence: Not until the last minute ___ she decide to join us.
exercises.translation: 直到最后一刻，她才决定加入我们。
options: does
did
has
was
exercises.explanation: Not until 引导的句子要倒装，过去时用助动词 did，后面的动词用原形 decide。

exercises.source: 要是你需要帮助，请随时给我们打电话。
options: Should you need help, please call us at any time.
Should you needed help, please call us at any time.
Need you should help, please call us at any time.
Should you need help, please calling us at any time.
exercises.explanation: Should you need 是 if you need 的倒装形式，动词用原形 need；calling 与 needed 的用法都是错的。

exercises.source: 他一到家，雨就开始下了。
options: Hardly he had arrived home when it started to rain.
Hardly had he arrived home than it started to rain.
Hardly had he arrived home when it started to rain.
Hardly he arrived home when it started to rain.
exercises.explanation: hardly 位于句首时要倒装为 Hardly had he arrived，并与 when 搭配，不能用 than。

options: Rarely the trains are late here.
Seldom do we see snow in this city.
Not only did he call, but he also visited.
exercises.explanation: Rarely 位于句首，必须倒装为 Rarely are the trains late here.，不能保持陈述语序。

options: Never before have I felt so nervous.
Never before I have felt so nervous.
Not only is it cheap, but it is also tasty.
exercises.explanation: Never before 位于句首，必须倒装；正确形式是 Never before have I felt so nervous.。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 我从未见过如此美丽的景色。
exercises.explanation: 否定副词 never 置于句首，之后是“助动词 + 主语 + 过去分词”。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 要是我早知道会延误，我早就走了。
exercises.explanation: 省略 if 的倒装条件句：Had + 主语 + V3，主句仍用 would have + V3。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 乐队演奏得如此响亮，邻居们都投诉了。
exercises.explanation: So + 副词位于句首时，后面要倒装：So loudly did ... that ...。
